name: Lantern-Bellied Frog Pond
description: A midnight pond full of friendly frogs with glowing lantern-like bellies illuminating the garden.
prompt: A single enchanting midnight scene of a lily pond where plump frogs have softly glowing lantern-like bellies. Their warm light illuminates lily pads, reeds, dragonflies, and rippling water. Fireflies hover, a crescent moon reflects in the pond. Rich emerald and gold palette, whimsical storybook style, peaceful and magical, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: These little frogs carry their own moonlight. Would you follow the lantern-bellied choir?
